biw_news.title: Subaru Announces Dedicated Next-Generation EV Platform Architecture for 2029
biw_news.summary: Subaru has unveiled initial details regarding its upcoming dedicated EV platform slated for 2029. The modular skateboard chassis architecture is engineered to optimize battery pack structural integration and enhance torsional rigidity.

biw_news.title: BMW Neue Klasse Architecture Underpins New iX4 Electric Crossover
biw_news.summary: The new BMW iX4 leverages the advanced Neue Klasse vehicle architecture, integrating a high-density battery pack as a core structural element of the monocoque chassis. This design enhances torsional stiffness and optimizes crash load paths.

biw_news.title: JLR Utilizes Advanced Lightweight Monocoque Structure for Jaguar Type 01 EV
biw_news.summary: Jaguar's new Type 01 luxury electric vehicle relies on a heavily optimized, lightweight aluminum-intensive body structure. The advanced chassis architecture manages the immense output while maintaining stringent structural crashworthiness standards.

biw_news.title: Mercedes-AMG GT SUV Introduces High-Performance Tri-Motor Powertrain on Rigid Chassis
biw_news.summary: The Mercedes-AMG GT SUV demands heavy structural reinforcements to accommodate its high-output tri-motor layout and massive torque loads. The chassis features reinforced suspension hardpoints and specialized subframes to handle hypercar-level dynamic stresses.

biw_news.title: BYD Atto 8 Integrates High-Capacity Battery Pack into Skateboard Chassis Structure
biw_news.summary: BYD's range-topping Atto 8 employs an expansive 115kWh battery pack configured within a cell-to-body structural arrangement. This integration improves overall platform bending rigidity and maximizes interior space for a 7-seat layout.

biw_news.title: Mahindra Expands Global Commercial Lineup with Rigid Scorpio Lifestyler Pickup Chassis
biw_news.summary: The Mahindra Scorpio N-derived Lifestyler pickup utilizes a robust ladder-frame chassis engineered for heavy payload capacity and rugged off-road torsional durability. The body-on-frame architecture features reinforced crossmembers and redesigned rear suspension mounting points.
